scope: All 165 S06 files, all 10 multilabel code/launcher files of S11, both S04 TEX reports. S01 exact copies are references; snapshot must preserve its own structure. S11 raw dataset is covered by dataset audit.
unit_policy: L1 original rows/events; L2 fingerprint groups with OR labels. Derived binary metrics remain in their multilabel run.
variant_policy: L1 main report/result is job3151 CPU and resumes earlier states. Historical S04 revised report matches job2625 GPU. L2 is job3315 CPU.
checkpoint_policy: Preserve all original checkpoint joblib files in heavy artifacts; no model was loaded. Identical SHA256 is binary identity, not semantic interchangeability of differing pickles.
